turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are store loyalty cards actually worth it, or is it just them tracking me?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Honestly, it's a bit of both. They do collect your shopping data, and in return you get points or member prices.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some supermarkets now show two prices, and only card holders get the lower one. That can add up over a year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm. I shop at the same place every week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then the card probably pays off for you. If the tracking bothers you, check the privacy settings, some let you opt out of marketing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Points are usually worth very little each, but they build up slowly. Just don't buy things only to earn them.
